title: Matthew Chapter 22 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Matthew chapter 22 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Matthew Chapter 22 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Matthew Chapter 22.

questions.question: What did the king prepare for his son's marriage?
questions.correctAnswer: A great feast
questions.explanation: The king prepared a dinner for the marriage, as stated in Matthew 22:4.

questions.question: True or False: The king was pleased when his servants returned with the news that those invited to the wedding would not come.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: The king was wroth when he heard that those invited would not come, according to Matthew 22:7.

questions.question: Who did the king send to invite to the wedding after the first guests declined?
questions.correctAnswer: Other servants
questions.explanation: The king sent forth other servants to invite those who were bidden, as mentioned in Matthew 22:4.

questions.question: True or False: The guests who were invited to the wedding came immediately when called.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: The invited guests made light of the invitation and went their ways, as stated in Matthew 22:5.

questions.question: What ultimately happened to the city of those who mistreated the king's servants?
questions.correctAnswer: It was destroyed
questions.explanation: The king sent forth his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city, according to Matthew 22:7.

questions.question: What did the king say to his servants about the guests who were bidden?
questions.correctAnswer: They are not worthy
questions.explanation: The king stated that those who were bidden were not worthy, as mentioned in Matthew 22:8.

questions.question: True or False: The king ordered that a man without a wedding garment be cast into outer darkness.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: The king commanded that the man without a wedding garment be bound and cast into outer darkness, according to Matthew 22:13.

questions.question: According to Jesus, how many are called and how many are chosen?
options: Many are called, few are chosen
All are called, few are chosen
Few are called, many are chosen
Few are called, few are chosen
questions.correctAnswer: Many are called, few are chosen
questions.explanation: Jesus said, 'For many are called, but few are chosen,' as stated in Matthew 22:14.

questions.question: Who was sent to tempt Jesus with a question about tribute?
questions.correctAnswer: The Pharisees
questions.explanation: The Pharisees sent their disciples with the Herodians to tempt Jesus, as stated in Matthew 22:15.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus affirmed that it was lawful to give tribute unto Caesar.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Jesus instructed to render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's, affirming the lawfulness of tribute, according to Matthew 22:21.

questions.question: In Matthew 22, which instruction comes before all the others listed here?
options: Call those bidden to the wedding
Bind the man without the wedding garment
questions.correctAnswer: Call those bidden to the wedding
questions.explanation: The first instruction was to send forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding, as stated in Matthew 22:3.

medium.title: Matthew Chapter 22 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Matthew Chapter 22 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What did the king prepare for the marriage in Matthew 22?
questions.correctAnswer: A feast
questions.explanation: The king prepared a feast as stated in Matthew 22:4, where he says, 'Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.'

questions.question: According to Matthew 22:14, what does it mean that 'many are called, but few are chosen'?
options: Not all who are invited will attend
Only the wise will be chosen
questions.correctAnswer: Not all who are invited will attend
questions.explanation: This phrase indicates that while many are invited to God's kingdom, only a select few will respond and be chosen, as illustrated in the parable of the wedding feast.

questions.question: True or False: The Pharisees sent their disciples to Jesus to genuinely seek the truth.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: The Pharisees sent their disciples to tempt Jesus, not to seek the truth, as indicated in Matthew 22:15, 'Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.'

questions.question: What did Jesus say about paying tribute to Caesar in Matthew 22?
options: Render unto Caesar what is Caesar's
questions.correctAnswer: Render unto Caesar what is Caesar's
questions.explanation: Jesus instructed them to pay tribute to Caesar, indicating the importance of fulfilling earthly obligations while also recognizing God's authority, as stated in Matthew 22:21.

questions.question: How did Jesus respond to the Sadducees' question about the resurrection?
options: He said they erred not knowing the scriptures
questions.correctAnswer: He said they erred not knowing the scriptures
questions.explanation: Jesus corrected the Sadducees by stating in Matthew 22:29, 'Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.'

questions.question: According to Matthew 22:30, what is true about those who rise from the dead?
options: They will be as the angels
questions.correctAnswer: They will be as the angels
questions.explanation: Jesus explained that in the resurrection, people neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like the angels of God in heaven, as noted in Matthew 22:30.

questions.question: True or False: The Sadducees believed in the resurrection.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: The Sadducees are described as those who say there is no resurrection, as seen in Matthew 22:23.

questions.question: What is the first and great commandment according to Jesus in Matthew 22?
questions.correctAnswer: Love the Lord your God
questions.explanation: Jesus stated in Matthew 22:37, 'Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.'

questions.question: What does Matthew 22:40 imply about the commandments?
options: All the law and the prophets hang on two commandments
questions.correctAnswer: All the law and the prophets hang on two commandments
questions.explanation: Jesus taught that all the law and the prophets depend on the commandments to love God and neighbor, as stated in Matthew 22:40.

questions.question: What did Jesus ask the Pharisees about the Christ's lineage in Matthew 22?
options: What think ye of Christ? whose son is he?
questions.correctAnswer: What think ye of Christ? whose son is he?
questions.explanation: Jesus directly asked the Pharisees about the identity of the Christ in Matthew 22:42, prompting them to reflect on His lineage.

questions.question: True or False: No man was able to answer Jesus after He questioned them about David calling Christ Lord.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: The text notes in Matthew 22:46 that no man was able to answer him a word after this profound question, indicating their inability to comprehend His teaching.

questions.question: What lesson can be learned about humility from Matthew 22:18, where Jesus calls the Pharisees hypocrites?
options: Recognize our flaws and seek truth
questions.correctAnswer: Recognize our flaws and seek truth
questions.explanation: Jesus confronted the Pharisees' hypocrisy, teaching that true humility involves recognizing one's flaws and genuinely seeking truth, as emphasized in Matthew 22:18.

hard.title: Matthew Chapter 22 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Matthew Chapter 22.

questions.question: What is the first and great commandment according to Jesus?
options: Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself
Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind
Thou shalt have no other gods before me
questions.correctAnswer: Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind
questions.explanation: Jesus identifies this commandment as the foremost in Matthew 22:37, emphasizing the total devotion to God.

questions.question: What did Jesus say about the resurrection in relation to marriage?
options: They neither marry nor are given in marriage
questions.correctAnswer: They neither marry nor are given in marriage
questions.explanation: In Matthew 22:30, Jesus explains that those resurrected are like angels and do not marry.

questions.question: Which two commandments does Jesus say hang all the law and the prophets?
options: Love God and love your neighbor
Fear God and keep His commandments
Honor your father and mother and love your neighbor
Worship God and trust in His promises
questions.correctAnswer: Love God and love your neighbor
questions.explanation: According to Matthew 22:40, these two commandments summarize the entire law and the teachings of the prophets.

questions.question: What did the Pharisees seek to do when they sent their disciples to Jesus?
questions.correctAnswer: Entangle Him in His talk
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:15 states that the Pharisees aimed to trap Jesus with their questions.

questions.question: Which king in Jesus' parable made a marriage for his son?
questions.correctAnswer: A certain king
questions.explanation: Jesus introduces the parable of the marriage with 'a certain king' in Matthew 22:2, symbolizing God.

questions.question: What was the reaction of the multitude when they heard Jesus' teaching on the resurrection?
questions.correctAnswer: They were astonished
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:33 states that the multitude was amazed at Jesus' doctrine regarding the resurrection.

questions.question: What did Jesus say about the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob?
options: He is the God of the dead
He is the God of the living
He is the God of the angels
questions.correctAnswer: He is the God of the living
questions.explanation: Jesus clarifies that God is not the God of the dead but of the living in Matthew 22:32.

questions.question: How did Jesus respond to the question about paying tribute to Caesar?
questions.correctAnswer: He asked for a coin
questions.explanation: In Matthew 22:19, Jesus asked for the tribute money to illustrate His point about obligations to both God and man.

questions.question: True or False: The Sadducees believed in the resurrection.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:23 indicates that the Sadducees, who questioned Jesus, did not believe in the resurrection.

questions.question: In Matthew 22:44, who does David call 'Lord'?
questions.correctAnswer: The Messiah
questions.explanation: Jesus references Psalm 110:1, where David calls the Messiah 'Lord', indicating His divine authority.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus taught that many are called but few are chosen.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: This statement is found in Matthew 22:14, reflecting on the selective nature of God's calling.

questions.question: Which literary device is used in Matthew 22:37-39 when presenting the commandments?
questions.correctAnswer: Parallelism
questions.explanation: The structure of the commandments showcases parallelism, highlighting the relationship between loving God and loving neighbor.

questions.question: Which Old Testament commandment does Jesus reference as the second greatest commandment?
options: You shall not bear false witness
You shall love your neighbor as yourself
questions.correctAnswer: You shall love your neighbor as yourself
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:39 cites Leviticus 19:18, where loving one’s neighbor is emphasized as a key commandment.

questions.question: How does Matthew 22 connect to the theme of God's invitation in other parables?
options: It illustrates God's invitation to all
It suggests only the righteous are invited
questions.correctAnswer: It illustrates God's invitation to all
questions.explanation: Similar to the parable of the Great Banquet in Luke 14, Matthew 22 highlights God's invitation extended beyond the originally chosen.

theological.title: Matthew Chapter 22 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Matthew Chapter 22 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What does the parable of the marriage in Matthew 22 teach about God's invitation to salvation?
options: It shows that only the righteous are invited.
It demonstrates God's desire to include all people.
It indicates that the invitation is only for the wealthy.
It proves that God's call is limited to Israel.
questions.correctAnswer: It demonstrates God's desire to include all people.
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:9 emphasizes the king's command to invite everyone from the highways, indicating God's inclusive invitation to salvation.

questions.question: In Matthew 22, what does the king do to those who reject his invitation to the wedding feast?
options: He ignores them and invites others.
He becomes angry and punishes them.
He sends them gifts to persuade them.
He asks them to reconsider politely.
questions.correctAnswer: He becomes angry and punishes them.
questions.explanation: In Matthew 22:7, the king's wrath leads to the destruction of those murderers and the burning of their city, illustrating God's judgment on rejection.

questions.question: What was the reaction of the guests when they were invited to the wedding?
options: They made light of it and refused to come.
They were confused and did not understand.
They fought over who would attend.
questions.correctAnswer: They made light of it and refused to come.
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:5 states that the invited guests made light of the invitation and went their own ways, illustrating human indifference to God's call.

questions.question: What does the king's question to the man without a wedding garment reveal about the nature of the kingdom of heaven?
options: It shows that attire is unimportant.
It indicates that all who enter must be prepared.
It teaches that only the rich are accepted.
It demonstrates that the kingdom is exclusive.
questions.correctAnswer: It indicates that all who enter must be prepared.
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:12 reveals the king's concern for proper attire, symbolizing the necessity of being spiritually prepared to enter the kingdom.

questions.question: According to Matthew 22, what is revealed about the Sadducees' understanding of the resurrection?
options: They believe in the resurrection of the dead.
They err in their knowledge of Scripture.
questions.correctAnswer: They err in their knowledge of Scripture.
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:29 indicates that Jesus rebuked the Sadducees for their error, highlighting their misunderstanding of both Scripture and God's power.

questions.question: What does Jesus teach about marriage in the resurrection as per Matthew 22?
options: People will marry as they do on earth.
There will be no marriage in the resurrection.
questions.correctAnswer: There will be no marriage in the resurrection.
questions.explanation: In Matthew 22:30, Jesus states that in the resurrection, people neither marry nor are given in marriage, indicating a different state of existence.

questions.question: What does Jesus say about the nature of God in Matthew 22?
options: He is the God of the dead.
He is the God of the living.
He is indifferent to human affairs.
He only cares for the righteous.
questions.correctAnswer: He is the God of the living.
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:32 reveals God's identity as the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, emphasizing that He is not the God of the dead but of the living.

questions.question: What does the interaction between Jesus and the Pharisees in Matthew 22 reveal about their intentions?
options: They seek to learn from Him.
They want to trap Him in His words.
They are indifferent to His teaching.
questions.correctAnswer: They want to trap Him in His words.
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:15 shows that the Pharisees conspired how to entangle Jesus in His talk, revealing their adversarial intentions.

questions.question: What is the significance of Jesus' teaching on giving tribute to Caesar?
options: It suggests that political allegiance is unimportant.
It emphasizes the separation of church and state.
It demonstrates the importance of rendering to authorities.
It shows that money is more valuable than faith.
questions.correctAnswer: It demonstrates the importance of rendering to authorities.
questions.explanation: In Matthew 22:21, Jesus teaches to render unto Caesar what is Caesar's, which underscores the obligation to fulfill civic duties.

questions.question: What is the great commandment according to Jesus in Matthew 22?
options: To love your neighbor as yourself.
To love the Lord with all your heart, soul, and mind.
questions.correctAnswer: To love the Lord with all your heart, soul, and mind.
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:37 records Jesus stating that the first and great commandment is to love the Lord with all one's heart, soul, and mind.

questions.question: According to Matthew 22, how are the two great commandments related?
options: One is more important than the other.
They are both foundational to the law.
questions.correctAnswer: They are both foundational to the law.
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:40 states that on these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets, highlighting their centrality to biblical teaching.

questions.question: What does David's reference to the Messiah in Matthew 22 imply about Christ's identity?
options: He is merely a descendant of David.
He is recognized as Lord by David.
He is a prophet like Moses.
questions.correctAnswer: He is recognized as Lord by David.
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:44 shows that David calls the Messiah Lord, indicating that Christ's authority transcends that of David, affirming His divine identity.

questions.question: What does the astonishment of the multitude reveal about Jesus' teaching in Matthew 22?
options: They were confused by His parables.
They were indifferent to His authority.
They were impressed by His wisdom.
questions.correctAnswer: They were impressed by His wisdom.
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:33 states that the multitude was astonished at His doctrine, indicating the profound impact of His teachings on them.

questions.question: How does Matthew 22 illustrate the concept of divine election?
options: Many are called, but few are chosen.
questions.correctAnswer: Many are called, but few are chosen.
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:14 summarizes the parable's message that though invitations to the kingdom are extended widely, only a few respond appropriately.
